recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31352; future patient-proficiency context changes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-31352 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked whether the patient-proficiency extension, then limited to Patient.communication, should also be usable on RelatedPerson.communication; the final resolution required changing the extension to support both RelatedPerson.communication and Person.communication.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit 6b4860e939c4fe9e6e99fb60ba6f293a31faa856 applied the request by adding RelatedPerson.communication and Person.communication contexts to source/patient/structuredefinition-extension-patient-proficiency.xml.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed patient extension definitions and the patient-proficiency entry from the core Patient implementation guide. The current authoritative extension definition is in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-patient-proficiency.xml, where it lists Patient.communication, RelatedPerson.communication, Practitioner.communication, and Person.communication contexts. FHIR-34874 is a later same-extension issue for Practitioner.communication and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no HL7/fhir source change is appropriate: the requested context expansion is already present in the FHIR Extension Pack, and the extension's absence from core is an intentional source move.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue added Practitioner.communication to the same patient-proficiency extension; it is already represented on the combined branch by 92e77c1084138ddad8331e643b3d57a82e75ace9.
